hard-negative-pairs-v1.limitations: Comparisons share original audio and expert labels; no new independent audio or natural-error labels.

hard-negative-strong-pairs-v1.limitations: Comparisons share original audio and expert labels; no new independent audio or natural-error labels.
hard-negative-strong-pairs-v1.maskPolicy: Existing source alignment flags; train only, never calibration.

hard-negative-native-pairs-v2.limitations: OMPAL components use expert votes; AISHELL components use human-listened source pinyin with machine-estimated boundaries. Pairs share original audio; source identifiers do not prove distinct people across corpora.

hard-negative-eduhk-pairs-v1.limitations: OMPAL expert votes, AISHELL source human pinyin and EdUHK explicit human error annotations. EdUHK word order and boundaries are not independently verified. Research use only.
